title: Stale doc on set_wall_clock_unix: mod.rs says clockless 'treats every well-formed signature as unexpired' but the gate does Baseline (treat as unsigned) per R-06-307
description: Review finding (b7z9.88.3 correctness pass): rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/mod.rs:157-162 doc comment states that without a wall clock the receiver 'treats every well-formed signature as unexpired'. The implementation (receive.rs:709-712) and the R-06-307 pins do the opposite: unassessable clock -> DioRootSigOutcome::Baseline (treat as UNSIGNED, spec 8.10.1 'expired -> treat as unsigned' applied to the unassessable case). The doc draws the inverted conclusion from the same spec line and misdocuments a security-critical semantic. One-comment fix, align doc with receive.rs:706-715.
close_reason: Doc aligned with the gate: mod.rs set_wall_clock_unix now documents receiver-side unassessable-clock degradation (otherwise-valid signed DIO -> Baseline/treat-as-unsigned, forged/tampered still reject) and the root-producer role (root-sig feature: clock sets transmitted signature expiry; without it root DIOs go unsigned). rpl_stack suite green, cargo doc clean. 3x delegated review run: pass1+2 PASS, pass3 producer-role gap incorporated before close.
